title: A bad cold
description: A bilingual lesson about Jimmy's bad cold, calling the doctor and what he must do, with workbook practice on fill-in dialogue and illness vocabulary, plus grammar on have/has, must and why-questions. 关于吉米得了重感冒、请医生以及他必须做什么的双语课程，配合教材填空对话和疾病词汇练习，以及 have/has、must 和 why 问句的语法练习。
answer_note: Textbook reading answer is labelled suggested. Workbook answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 61 key. Practice B is a free sorting exercise: the supplied key lists which phrases belong under each verb, and the sentence task is open-ended; the supplied model sentences are labelled suggested. In grammar II the two printed model questions are accepted answers; the key omits the question lines for those two items, which the supplied answers retain. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 61 grammar key (PDF pages 478-479). No external sources were used.

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. What is good news for Jimmy?
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。吉米有什么好消息？

lines.speaker: Mr. Williams
lines.text: Can you remember the doctor's telephone number?
lines.translation: 你还记得医生的电话号码吗？

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text:
Open your mouth, Jimmy.
Show me your tongue.
Say, 'Ah'.
lines.translation: 把嘴张开，吉米。让我看看你的舌头。说“啊——”

lines.speaker: Mr. Williams
lines.text: What's the matter with him, doctor?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text:
He has a bad cold, Mr. Williams,
so he must stay in bed
for a week.
lines.translation: 他得了重感冒，威廉斯先生，因此他必须卧床一周。

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.translation: 对吉米来说，这可是个好消息。

lesson.title: Before-reading question
lesson.instruction: Listen to the tape then answer this question. What is good news for Jimmy? 听录音，然后回答问题。吉米有什么好消息？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue. 根据对话回答问题。
lesson.context: The doctor says Jimmy has a bad cold and must stay in bed for a week, so he does not have to go to school.

questions.prompt: What is good news for Jimmy?
questions.answer: He has a bad cold, so he must stay in bed for a week and does not have to go to school.

items.title: What's the matter with him?
items.text:
他怎么啦？
What's the matter with ...? 常用来询问人或事物的状况，常作“是否有问题？”“是否有麻烦”讲。

items.title: feel ill
items.text: 觉得病了，feel 是系动词，ill 是表语。注意 feel ill 和 look ill 在意思上的区别：前者指自我感觉，后者指外表形象。

items.title: It's 09754
items.text: 其中 It's 指“电话号码是”。

items.title: That's good news
items.text: That's good news 中的 news 是不可数名词，不是复数形式。

items.title: Good news?
items.text: 是省略句，完整的句子应为 Is it good news?

lesson.text:
参考译文
威廉斯先生：吉米在哪儿？
威廉斯夫人：他躺在床上。
威廉斯先生：他怎么啦？
威廉斯夫人：他觉得不舒服。

威廉斯先生：他看上去是病了。
威廉斯夫人：我们得去请医生。
威廉斯先生：是的，一定得请。

威廉斯先生：你还记得医生的电话号码吗？
威廉斯夫人：记得。是 09754。

医生：把嘴张开，吉米。让我看看你的舌头。说“啊——”

威廉斯先生：他得了什么病，医生？
医生：他得了重感冒，威廉斯先生，因此他必须卧床一周。

威廉斯夫人：对吉米来说，这可是个好消息。
医生：好消息？为什么？
威廉斯先生：因为他不喜欢上学。

practice.title: A Dialogue

practice.translation: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing words.
practice.context: Complete each dialogue turn. Multiple blanks in one printed sentence are one answer field; answers are listed in blank order.

Mr. Williams: And he looks ______. Open your ______, Jimmy, and show ______ your ______.

practice.title: B Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Write these words and phrases under the correct verbs below. 将以下词和短语列入正确的栏目之下。
practice.translation: Sort the printed phrases under the verb that they can follow.
practice.context: The supplied key assigns the phrases: have — a headache, an earache, a toothache, a stomach ache, a temperature, flu, measles, mumps; take — some medicine; see — a doctor, a dentist; stay — in bed, at home. Items 1 and 6 are printed examples and are not editable.

practice.title: C Sentences
practice.instruction:
Now write three sentences like the examples to answer these questions. 模仿例句为以下问题写出 3 个回答。
What's the matter with you today? What must you do? Who must you see?
practice.translation: Write three sentences like the printed examples to answer the questions.
practice.context: Printed example: I have a bad cold today. I must stay at home and take some medicine. And I must see a doctor. The supplied key marks this exercise open-ended and gives possible sentences: I have a bad toothache today. I must take an aspirin. And I must see a dentist.

questions.prompt: I must stay at home and take some ______.
What's the matter with you today? What must you do? Who must you see?
questions.answer: I have a bad toothache today. I must take an aspirin. And I must see a dentist.
